scope: Test-harness failures retained separately from successful final checks; emulator behavior was not weakened.

cases.failure: Default Python model rebuild lacked numpy
cases.correction: Use the existing model virtual environment with declared requirements; public rebuild then byte-identical

cases.failure: Initial locator capture was 600 px or 800 by 801 px, rejected by exact-size verifier
cases.correction: Place actual canvas at integer fixed origin and 800 by 800 CSS pixels; capture without resizing/warping

cases.failure: Material test supplied the wrong appearance argument shape
cases.correction: Use shell.color/opacity/finish contract, then repeat original/gold/purple views

cases.failure: Async waitForFunction predicate was treated as truthy before actual guest readiness; first input returned NOT_RUNNING
cases.correction: Explicitly await observe() in a bounded polling loop and require complete UART sample lines; failed attempt is not acceptance evidence
